title: Merge Sorted Streams
description: Given k sorted integer streams, merge all their values into one globally sorted sequence.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 100; each stream contains at least one value; total number of values <= 100000; each stream is sorted in non-decreasing order.
inputFormat: First line: k. For each stream, one line contains its length followed by its sorted values.
outputFormat: Print all values from all streams in non-decreasing order separated by spaces.
hints: Keep the smallest current value from every stream in a min-heap and replace it whenever that stream advances.

examples.explanation: The three sorted streams are combined into one sorted sequence.
The smallest current element is repeatedly selected across both streams.
